title: MET Writing Practice — 76 Prompts (Task 1 elaborated + Task 2 essays) - 10 minutes

structure.ordering: Task 1 and Task 2 prompts alternate as much as possible; remaining Task 1 items are placed at the end.

prompts.prompt: Describe your current level of education or your most recent studies. What are or were your main subjects, and why did you choose them?
prompts.instructions: Write a few well-developed sentences (about 80–120 words). Answer the question directly, give specific details or examples, and explain your ideas clearly.
